blocks.text: Deduction is a type of reasoning that starts from general facts to reach a specific conclusion. Logical rules like “if-then” statements are used in deduction. For example, “If it rains, the ground gets wet” and “It is raining” lead to the conclusion “The ground is wet.” Deduction is reliable because the conclusion is guaranteed to be true if the premises are true. Computers use deduction to solve problems and answer questions. Deduction helps in formal reasoning and problem-solving tasks.
